experiment: Round10: a single fixed robust return-loss intervention
scope: Research only, on the same repeatedly inspected141 validation Fridays in2018-2020. No new prices, assets, dates, architecture, sample selection, target scaling or training-budget search. No live changes or independent-confirmation claim.
data: Byte-copy round9 full-history masks and observation table. Reuse round5 raw125-bar OHLCV windows and executable weekly-return/five-bar OHLCV labels. Every training label must be jointly complete by cutoff. Use the exact legacy full-training mean and population SD, floor1e-6, for both heads. No robust rescaling or label clipping.
model: Frozen research_v6.models6.make_model('combined',seed),38551 parameters,d_model16/d_ff32,dropout0.3,two layers. AdamW, initialization, gradient clipping and three seeds unchanged.
baseline: Reuse nine frozen full-history combined20 MSE models and423 seed predictions. Restore the original128-row batching, including last batches14,1,117; round9 balanced batching was not adopted. Preserve original NumPy permutation streams, optimizer step counts14/16/17 per epoch and20 epochs.
candidate: Only return loss changes. For standardized return residual e=prediction-target, use rho(e)=e^2 if|e|<=1, otherwise2|e|-1; this is2*Huber(delta1), preserving the original small-error curvature and scale. Derivative is2*clip(e,-1,1). Joint batch loss is mean rho(return residual)+0.1*mean squared auxiliary residual. Auxiliary loss, data and target scales remain unchanged. The threshold is fixed in train-SD units, never chosen from validation.
attribution_limit: Robust loss limits the influence of large residuals, which may arise from large labels or poor predictions; it does not remove observations. It changes the conditional location being targeted, so it need not improve conditional-mean MSE. Unchanged auxiliary MSE can still respond strongly to extremes. Global clipping and AdamW mean bounded scalar loss derivatives do not imply bounded model updates. Return losses are not directly comparable across MSE and Huber objectives; compare final training MSE separately.
constant_references: Retain the causal training mean and zero-return references. Add a training-only Huber intercept for each fold: solve mean clip(c-z_i,-1,1)=0 for standardized training labels z, by deterministic160-step bisection between min(z)-1 and max(z)+1; raw prediction=mean+sd*c. No validation labels or tuning enter this constant. It prevents a changed forecast center from being mistaken for useful input information.
budget: Nine new neural fits=three folds x three seeds, epoch20 checkpoint only. Reuse nine MSE models. Three deterministic scalar Huber intercept solutions, no hyperparameter grid. Replay all18 neural checkpoints. One training worker. No outcome-dependent additional fits or candidate selection.
primary: Three paired weekly MSE comparisons of the three-seed Huber ensemble: versus archived MSE ensemble, versus training mean, versus training-only Huber intercept. Circular block bootstrap,block8 observations,10000 replicates,seed20260910,centered two-sided p,Holm across all three. Percentile95% intervals are descriptive and need not invert the centered test. Direction accuracy, MAE and standardized Huber error are secondary diagnostics.
descriptive_screen: All six flags are required: ensemble MSE beats archived model; ensemble MSE beats training mean; ensemble MSE beats Huber intercept; at least2/3 new seeds beat both constant references; at least2/3 matched seeds beat archived models; at least2/3 years beat archived ensemble. Report all counts, seeds and years. This local descriptive screen is not statistical confirmation, independent evidence or strategy promotion.
training_only_audit: Reuse the frozen round8 training predictions of all nine archived MSE models, with original target scales, to compare same-residual MSE versus2*Huber loss and scalar derivative concentration. Report fraction|e|>1,top1% residual loss shares, scalar absolute-derivative shares and yearly attribution. Also audit zero-standardized-return initialization. These are output-loss diagnostics, not actual parameter-gradient attribution. No fitting choices depend on the audit.
diagnostics: Final standardized training MSE and auxiliary MSE; final robust loss and linear-region fraction; new pre-clipping gradient norms and clipping fractions; all seed/year scores; whole-window cyclic input reassignment within each validation fold; forecast SD and changes relative to matched archived predictions; constant-reference performance. Validation windows remain unchanged.
verification: Freeze source, protocol, input, previous evidence, masks, scales, intercepts and fit plan. Test scaled-Huber formula/derivative against the installed PyTorch implementation, scalar intercept optimality, maturity and budgets, and exact model/RNG parity to legacy when all residuals are in the quadratic region. Replay all18 checkpoints, recompute180 epoch orders/boundaries, target scales and intercepts, metrics, three bootstrap tests and six flags. Preserve all preceding artifacts.
